description: This file defines the EmployeeDTO class, which is a Data Transfer Object used for messaging or data serialization. It includes fields for employee attributes such as id, firstName, surname, role, and a list of associated ProjectDTO objects. The class implements Serializable and provides getter/setter methods, as well as overridden equals, hashCode, and toString methods utilizing Apache Commons Lang builders.

classes.name: EmployeeDTO
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object representing an employee, including identification details and associated projects.
